decision.explanation: The source documents present two distinct, conflicting assertions regarding the electoral district associated with Torcy-et-Pouligny. Document 1 (D1S4, D1S6, D1S8, D1S9, D1S11, D1S13) explicitly states the commune is associated with the 'canton of Auterive'. Document 2 (D2S5, D2S8, D2S11) explicitly states the commune is part of the 'canton of Semur-en-Auxois'. Per the instruction to preserve separately valid referents and complementary answers where competing assertions exist without a mechanism to resolve them as errors, both answers are retained as they represent distinct claims found in the provided source material.
